title: Add a purchase order matching API
summary: New public codeunits in the Base Application let other apps, starting with E-Documents, create Matched Order Line records through a validated match group. A helper suggests receipts that could cover the remaining amount to invoice on an order.
key_points: New public codeunits act as a facade for inserting Matched Order Line records
PO Matching Group buffers matches and validates quantities, prepayment and item tracking rules as each match is added
Existing persisted matches are discovered breadth-first and loaded so validations consider them
Iterators expose the buffered matches and the invoiceable receipts
Additive change; existing BaseApp matching logic is not changed
